index_line: - [[psb-alpha-p3]] — 8 Ω (3.9 Ω min), LW ±3.1 dB, f3 62 Hz, sens 80.3 dB, pref 3.1 (ASR)
brand_notes: PSB Alpha series (2019 relaunch) uses inverted drivers (tweeter below woofer), magnetic grilles, L4 acoustic crossovers; maker claimed sensitivities run 3-5 dB above Klippel values (mfr-psb-alpha-p3, asr-psb-alpha-p3). PSB direct prices ($449 P3/$699 P5) are above US dealer prices.
takeaways: Tiny 4in ported two-way, 8 ohm rated but 3.9 ohm measured min (effectively-4ohm).
Klippel LW ±3.1 dB, f3 62 Hz, sens 80.3 dB vs 85 dB claimed.
ASR: port/woofer resonances, THD ~2.7% at 86 dB, >5% at 96 dB; not recommended.
Launch critics liked clean mids/highs but heard no bass below ~60 Hz.
conflicts: Launch critic praise vs ASR measurement criticism
log_bullets: Created speakers/psb-alpha-p3 and 4 source pages (ASR, SoundStage!, Trusted Reviews, mfr)
Conflict: sensitivity claimed 85 dB vs 80.3 dB; no user reports found
